C0.loc: Abstract and Section 3 (The Model), p. 1 and p. 4
C0.quote: model selection problems with strategic candidates as a contest game
C0.note: The paper analyses a contest game among candidates choosing effort levels, against a single Bayesian decision-maker who selects the top alpha fraction by noisy quality estimates. It covers fairness (demographic parity) in selection. No voting rule aggregates several agents' submitted inputs into a collective decision, so the paper is outside the voting scope.
